name: History Minor
school: College of Literature, Science, and the Arts

requirements.label: Minor requirements (from LSA)
requirements.hint: Requirements Minimum Credits: 15 Five courses (at least 15 credits), to be chosen in consultation with a faculty advisor, covering at least two of the following areas: North America, Latin America, Europe, the Middle East/Central Asia, Africa, Asia, and Transregional/Global.At least four of the five courses must be at the 200-level or above; at least two courses must be at the 300-level or higher. Constraints First-Year Seminars do not count toward the minor.Two mini-courses will equal one regular course.HISTORY 294, Explorations in History (when taken for two credits) will count as one course.AP and IB credit: AP and/or IB credits may not be used to satisfy requirements of the minor.
